annotations.title: See what's moving in your market

description: Use this when the person asks what's changing in their market or their buyers' markets, or needs a reason a buyer might act now. Returns relevance-ranked signals (trends, buyer pain, moves by the alternatives buyers weigh, regulatory and tech shifts, hiring and funding), each with its impact on buyers and a recommended action. Signals come from Market Pulse; if the account has no Market Pulse yet, it says so.

signalType.description: Optional filter to one signal category.
